note: Curated metadata summaries verified against NASA OSDR metadata endpoints. Research records are historical, are not live astronaut telemetry, and must be reviewed before scientific use.

datasets.title: Transcriptional profiling of livers from mice flown on Rodent Research Reference Mission-1 (RRRM-1)
datasets.subject_type: Animal research; 40 mice across age groups and flight/ground cohorts
datasets.study_design: Spaceflight and ground-control cohorts; tissue collection at multiple mission time points
datasets.description: NASA OSDR metadata describes forty female BALB/cAnNTac mice flown on the ISS. The investigation profiles liver transcription and compares age, spaceflight, and ground-control conditions. This is animal research, not a human astronaut twin study.
datasets.attribution: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR), OSD-379
limitations: Mouse tissue transcription data are not human astronaut physiological measurements.
Assay-specific units and collection details must be reviewed in original study files.

datasets.title: Effects of 14 days of confinement on blood gene expression profiles in men
datasets.mission: Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency isolation and confinement facility; not a spaceflight mission
datasets.subject_type: Human analog research; confined healthy male subjects
datasets.study_design: Two 14-day confinement experiments with blood sampling before and during confinement
datasets.measurement_type: Transcription profiling from whole blood RNA
datasets.description: NASA OSDR metadata describes short-term confinement research in male subjects at a JAXA isolation facility. The record reports gene-expression changes during 14-day confinement. It is not astronaut flight telemetry and is not an ISS mission study.
datasets.attribution: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR), OSD-542
limitations: Ground-based short-duration confinement is not equivalent to microgravity or long-duration spaceflight.
Human subject status does not mean astronaut subjects.

datasets.title: Rodent Research-3-CASIS: Mouse liver transcriptomic, proteomic, epigenomic and histology data
datasets.subject_type: Animal research; flight and ground-control mouse cohorts
datasets.study_design: Spaceflight mouse study with ground controls and countermeasure treatment
datasets.measurement_type: Protein expression, DNA methylation, transcription profiling, and molecular cellular imaging
datasets.description: NASA OSDR metadata describes mouse research on a potential countermeasure for loss of muscle and bone mass during spaceflight. The record includes mouse liver molecular and histology data.
datasets.attribution: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR), OSD-137
limitations: Mouse molecular and tissue data are not human astronaut measurements.
Countermeasure findings cannot be directly applied as clinical guidance.

datasets.title: Transcriptional analysis of dorsal skin from mice flown on the RR-7 mission
datasets.organism: Mus musculus (female C57BL/6J and C3H/HeJ mice)
datasets.subject_type: Animal research; two mouse strains in spaceflight and control cohorts
datasets.study_design: ISS rodent study with two mouse strains and microbiome/immune-system objectives
datasets.description: NASA OSDR metadata describes RR-7 mouse research investigating the space environment, gut microbiota, and associated immune, metabolic, and circadian effects.
datasets.attribution: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR), OSD-254
limitations: This is mouse research and the measurement described is dorsal-skin transcription.
Do not interpret the record as an environmental surface microbiology dataset or human astronaut telemetry.
